BL.role: Bernstein-Lange online on the rT770 walk (bl_sg --field fold, 64 lanes, DP 6) with this job's table loaded (BLAKE3-checked) before the target exists

BLaa.role: the BL-arm experiment's BL A/A: BL again on the same point and seed

BLplain.role: step-identity control: the BL binary with no table and rT770's own jumps and DP rule, on Q0 at seed 831000

cP.role: IC cold, the baseline row's cold arm: the rank-probe producer with B's verified cached factor-log table (setup + one-target online); its online interval is the primary's numerator

cPaa.role: A/A of cP: the same arm and code in its own process at another position

kP.role: IC rank stage, the baseline row's rank arm (KIC_RANK_SOLVE=frame): setup, rank stage to full rank, linear algebra, one target; K1's process gives P_IC

rT.role: the tuned single-target rho rT770 (Fold/64/DP6), A's configured worker

in_flight_not_baseline: claude/n83-rotkey, claude/n83-k899, claude/n83-onlineframe, claude/n83-closure, claude/n83-knownlog (unpushed or unrun)
baseline_at_freeze.row: the rank-probe producer (arms cP / kP), crypto 770f6a69, koblitz-n83-rankprobe-20261019/protocol.json, run 39214027289: end-to-end cold S 6.390, gap to rT770 64.0 [53.7, 78.0], online gap 0.129 [0.085, 0.183]; Online / BL: not measured on this row (B's 235 [61, 645] is an older producer)
baseline_at_freeze.source: docs/ic/BASELINES.md on origin/main 1158c2152 (fetched 2026-10-19), row n=83 a=1 K600

bl.budget: P_IC_ms = timing_ms.rank_stage + timing_ms.setup_total of this job's K1 kP process (the BL-arm experiment's definition: one cold in-job IC run with the rank stage on the execution CPU, one thread; base load, normal basis and self-test, root index, the rank stage, setup's other phases). run_schedule.py --phase budget writes it to ic_budget/precompute_receipt.json, which bl_table.py precompute reads
bl.budget_excluded: as in the BL-arm experiment: the construction of the retained K600 base (427.5 ms measured in koblitz-n83-replay-20261017), and linear algebra and the factor-log write (tens of ms); this can only favour the IC
bl.budget_pre_run_estimate_source: mean rank_stage + setup_total of the four kP rows of run 39214027289
bl.machinery: koblitz-n83-bl-arm-20261014 (claude/n83-bl-arm, PR #918) unchanged: its generated bl_sg, its bl_table.py (precompute and check), its arm.py (kinds bl_sg, bl_plain_sg), its control.py and its frozen protocol.json (rho_reference rT770; bl.dp_bits 6, bl_jump_seed 20261014, precompute_seed 20261015, the 256-round stop rule, the 40-byte table format, oracle_sample 4096 with seed 2026101402)
bl.matched_fraction_reported: P_IC / (E2E(kP, cP) - mean cP online), a secondary

classification: MEASUREMENT of the distance to precomputation rho (AGENTS.md 'Success criterion', 'Distance to rho': report the gap to Bernstein-Lange where setup is excluded). It is not an index-calculus improvement, it changes no IC code, and it never replaces or promotes a baseline row; its figures fill the n=83 row's 'Online / BL' column.

controls.bl_aa: the BL-arm experiment's: BL and BLaa walk steps identical on every point, and the geometric mean of BL / BLaa online with its 95% bootstrap interval inside [0.9, 1.1]
controls.bl_budget: bl_table.py precompute receipt PASS (budget reached, overrun at most 1% + 50 ms) and its budget equal to this job's P_IC
controls.bl_positive: bl-arm control.py --only pc69-rT770 (E_0 over GF(2^69), 256 known-answer targets, tables at 2^17 and 2^18 steps): status PASS by its own gates (amendment A1), and its rows.jsonl byte-identical to the archived run's (sha256 in inputs/archived_identities.json)
controls.bl_step_identity: BLplain on Q0 at seed 831000 takes 12,592,070 steps, equal to this job's rT on Q0 at seed 831000, and recovers 3141592653589793
controls.bl_table: bl-arm bl_table.py check: regeneration byte-identical, every record verified by the producer, a 4,096-record oracle.py sample
controls.ic_aa: cold cP / cPaa and online cP / cPaa, ratio of means over the points: point estimates inside [0.97, 1.03] (cold) and [0.95, 1.05] (online); and the gates make each point's relation and probe count identical

decision_rule.eligible: every gate and every control passes and every scheduled row is present

reading.bl_online_faster_than_ic: eligible and the lower bound of G > 1
reading.ic_online_faster_than_bl: eligible and the upper bound of G < 1
reading.no_result: not eligible: rows and failures are reported, no ratio is read

decision_rule.scope: instance-scoped Tier 1 (one GitHub runner, one pinned CPU, CPU-only; host class recorded by scripts/host_cpu_record.py); a measured BL arm on this curve, base and budget; not a speed of either method in general; no transfer to ECC2K-130 or E_0 over GF(2^83)

design.bl_seed_rule: BL and BLaa use the rT seed of the same point (the BL-arm experiment's rule: shared start streams, different jump tables)
design.process_model: one point per process, fresh process per run, one pinned CPU, one runner
design.rank_seeds_note: 901-904 are new (stacked 101-102, rank-cut 201-204, rank-probe 301-304; the scratch branches use 401-404, 501-504, 701, 801-816)
design.runtime_estimate: build and tests about 25 min (two crates); positive control about 2 min; K1 about 170 s; BL precompute about P_IC; table checks about 6 min; cold segment about 60 s (cP and cPaa about 23 s each, rT about 3 s, BL and BLaa about 4 s each with the table load); 64 segments plus K2-K4; total about 2.3 h, up to about 3 h
design.time_guard: skip a segment (rows skipped_time_guard) if elapsed + its estimate exceeds 300 min
design.within_segment_order: random.Random(2026101960 + i).shuffle (C<i>), random.Random(2026102060 + b) (K<b>, one arm), random.Random(2026102160) (O1)

gates: every scheduled row present and valid (exit 0, verified, schedule match, no memory event)
every IC process: the rank-probe arm.py checks (layout, fold, index digests, counters; kP: full rank and a factor-log table equal to B's archived table, log for log)
per point: one scalar across every arm on the point (cP, cPaa, rT, BL, BLaa, and kP on its unit), replayed as [d]G = Q in the pinned oracle
per point: one relation and one probe count across every IC process on the point
Q0: cP gives the archived Feistel relation and scalar with 1,987,852 probes; BL, BLplain and rT give 3141592653589793
every BL row: solved by the precomputed table or by its own walk (recorded), the table's entry count loaded, BL and BLaa steps identical

power.note: the prior is model-based (BL rows rescaled from B's budget); the interval's width ratio does not depend on that scale
power.rule: smallest n with median width ratio (upper/lower) <= 2.0 at BL scale 1

question: On EC1N83Ce1h35c7ced6b497 (a=1, n=83, r=8569786107849059), with the current n=83 baseline (the rank-probe producer, arms cP / kP, koblitz-n83-rankprobe-20261019, run 39214027289), how much faster online is a Bernstein-Lange precomputation rho whose precomputation costs what the IC's precomputation costs (the BL-arm experiment's matched budget, measured in this job), on 64 new public points; and what are the end-to-end cold S of IC, BL and the tuned rho rT770 and each one's gap to rT770?

sources.bl_restore: ../koblitz-n83-bl-arm-20261014/restore_sources.py: crypto 770f6a69 into its snapshot/ and the BL arms generated by exact, counted edits, checked against its own frozen protocol.json sources.sha256 and B's tier1_protocol.json
sources.ic_restore: ../koblitz-n83-rankprobe-20261019/restore.py: crypto 770f6a69 into its snapshots/r770 (reconcile extraction, reconcile and B digests) and the rank-probe producer derived by its make_online_source.py, checked against its own frozen protocol.json (online_source_sha256 and every local digest)

statistics.primary: G = mean cP online_ms / mean BL online_ms over the 64 cold points (the online gap, IC over BL, as B's 235 was stated); 95% percentile bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 2026101990, the points resampled with each point's (cP, BL) pair kept together
statistics.primary_is: a MEASUREMENT of the online distance to BL at matched precomputation, not an IC improvement
secondary: rho over BL: mean rT online / mean BL online (BL's online speedup over the single-target rho)
online gaps to rT770: cP / rT and BL / rT (means, bootstrap over points)

end-to-end cold per arm: IC = E2E(kP, cP) = mean timing_ms.rank_stage over K1-K4 + mean cP cold_in_process_ms (the baseline row's definition); BL = BL precompute_ms + median BL setup_ms (curve, jumps, table read and insert) + mean BL online_ms (the BL-arm experiment's definition); rT = mean (setup_ms + online_ms) of rT
S per arm = cold or online ms / (rT ms per step x sqrt(r)), this run's rT770 step
end-to-end cold gaps to rT770: IC E2E / rT cold (bootstrap: blocks, attempts within blocks, points) and BL cold / rT cold (bootstrap over points); cold IC / BL (about 1 by construction)
matched fraction P_IC / (E2E(kP, cP) - mean cP online)
medians, rows with BL faster, Q0 per arm
BL model check: mean BL steps / the frozen model at this table's covered count
table: T, alpha = T * 2^dp / l, duplicate walk ends
host: the host_cpu_record of the runner (model, flags, microcode, caches, kernel)

success_criterion: AGENTS.md 'Success criterion' ('Distance to rho'); a measurement, never an improvement
